i.norm: When the actual edit distance between the two inputs far exceeds the threshold, the limited-distance algorithm returns -1 to indicate "threshold exceeded". left = CharBuffer.allocate(1) → one NUL character ('\0') right = "y{Ux1x:{|e" → 10 characters threshold = 1 Transforming a 1-char string into a 10-char string requires at least 9 edits, which is well above the threshold of 1, so the expected distance is -1.
